title: Ascension
notes: NEW: Ascend items. In the Master League, +15 items can be ascended without limit (✦1, ✦2, ...), +4% base stats each. The endgame use for Gold and Mana Stones.
Paragon fix: the Master League HP growth wrongly applied to Paragon opponents too (about 4x HP). Paragon now has its own curve (+5% per level).
